resources.string: Le modeli ivaliwe. Engeza ithokheni yakho ye-Hugging Face kuqala.
I-Hugging Face ibuyise isimo se-HTTP %1$s.
Yamukela ilayisensi yemodeli ekhasini layo le-Hugging Face. Bese uzama futhi.
Ayikho indawo eyanele yokugcina kudivayisi yakho. Khulula cishe u-%1$s GB kuqala.
I-Hugging Face ayizange iyamukele ithokheni. Hlola ithokheni bese uzama futhi.
Ukuxhumana kumile ngesikhathi sokulanda. Cindezela u-Resume ukuze uqhubeke.

Imodeli yehlulekile ku-GPU. Inkumbulo ye-GPU incane kakhulu kunenkumbulo yesistimu. Ukuzama okulandelayo kuzosebenzisa i-CPU. Ukuze usebenzise i-CPU ngaso sonke isikhathi, setha i-Compute ku-CPU kuzilungiselelo. Ungaphinde ukhethe imodeli encane.
Imodeli ayilayishanga. Ifayela cishe lonakele. Susa imodeli kuzilungiselelo bese uyilanda futhi.
Imodeli iphelelwe yinkumbulo, noma yehlulekile. Khetha imodeli encane.
IGemma encane evela esizukulwaneni esedlule. Inekhwalithi enhle kanye nomongo wamathokheni angu-4K.
I-Gemma encane kunazo zonke evela ku-Google. Iyashesha kuwo wonke amadivayisi.
Isizukulwane esisha se-Gemma. Inikeza ikhwalithi ephezulu kudivayisi yakho.
Imodeli enkulu kunazo zonke. Ibhalela kahle kakhulu, kodwa idinga idivayisi enamandla.
Imodeli ejwayelekile esangena kudivayisi eyisisekelo.
Ihlakaniphe ngokusobala kunezinhlobo ezingaphansi kuka-1B. Idinga idivayisi esezingeni eliphakathi.
Imodeli encane yakamuva. Izinga liphezulu kakhulu ngosayizi wayo.
Incane kakhulu futhi iyashesha. Ilungele ukubhala kabusha ngokushesha, kodwa ukucabanga kwayo kulinganiselwe.
Ingxenye ye-AI yekhibhodi ilanda kusuka ku-Google Play. Zama futhi ngomzuzu.
Ingxenye ye-AI isiqedile ukufakwa. Vala bese uvula kabusha ikhibhodi ukuze uyisebenzise.
